prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production asset: faithful HD animation artwork for Sam & Max Hit the Road (1993), costume 97 in room 22, Tunnel of Love.

Image 1 is the exact ORIGINAL POSE ATLAS to redraw. Images 2 and 3 are approved Sam and Max master sheets for the same character design, ink and color treatment ONLY. The original atlas overrides a master's pose, framing and temporary gag colors. Do not render the master sheets. The slate gray background is padding and must become genuine transparent alpha.

Redraw exactly 4 complete separate source drawings on ONE 1536 x 1024 transparent canvas. Use the same 3 columns by 2 rows of 512 x 512 cells as image 1, left to right then top to bottom. Keep unused cells completely empty. Each original in its same cell and same position; ample transparent gaps between drawings. No labels, numbers, cell borders or background. Do not merge/split drawings or repeat a single pose to replace different frames.

SOURCE MEANING AND PHASE: The combined upper-body drawing turns from right profile toward back view. Max is in the foreground: first profile then turning fully away with the blank cream BACK OF HIS HEAD between long upright ears. Sam is behind him, turning away in blue gray jacket and hat with brown ears/hands and changing arm positions. By the last drawings both are viewed from behind. Preserve the exact overlaps and partial torso cutoff. No boat. No eyes or grin on the back of Max's head.

Faithfulness: trace the exact silhouette, proportions and internal geometry of every source, keeping head/torso size ratio, hats, muzzles, eyes, hands, grins and all overlaps. Turn each pixel cluster into the smooth drawn shape it represents. Same size and same viewing angle. Preserve partial drawings exactly; do not complete absent bodies. Clean dark continuous anti-aliased ink, flat clean colors with one shade and a few small highlights, same area colors as the original, same identity and line weight as approved masters. No pixel blocks, staircase edges, dithering, grain, texture, blur, gradients, photorealism or 3D. Do not enlarge heads, eyes, ears or hands relative to bodies. Keep the source's visible small disconnected motion marks; do not add decorative debris or glow.

Cell order and eventual source-size at 4x (not a license to fill the cell): 1: 1948, 176 x 212 HD pixels, 2: 1949, 168 x 216 HD pixels, 3: 1950, 176 x 224 HD pixels, 4: 1951, 168 x 216 HD pixels. The atlas is temporarily magnified for painting; final entire drawings will be placed at fixed 4x with their own soft alpha. Do not change relative shape to use empty cell space.

Output ONE 1536 x 1024 RGBA image with real transparent background. No boat unless this source explicitly includes one, no scenery, floor shadows, words, watermark or signature.

IMPORTANT FACE LOCK: In all these original frames Sam has a CLOSED mouth, a small plain curved ink line in the brown muzzle below his large black NOSE. The black shape in the middle of Sam's face is his NOSE, not an open mouth. Do not add a red tongue, lips, white teeth or open mouth to Sam. Preserve Max's own expression as shown. Where the source shows pink sole marks on Max's dangling feet, keep those narrow pink marks; do not invent pads where they are absent.

VIEW LOCK: Sam is already viewed from behind in ALL FOUR sources: draw the back of his fedora, back of his jacket, brown drooping ears and only the small far-right edge of his muzzle in the first frame where visible. Do not add visible eyes or a frontal face to Sam. Max is viewed in right profile in cells 1 and 2, and completely from behind with no face in cells 3 and 4.
